correctness.rationale: The exact cyclic list of all 8 crossing edges in a dense signed-permutation chamber gives the rational shoelace formula. This is verified symbolically on the full algebraic chamber and extends to walls by continuity. At fixed b/a=s, the numerator N(s,r) of the logarithmic derivative in c^2/a^2=r decreases and has nonnegative endpoint value 6s(1-s)^2; strict interior positivity forces the body diagonal as unique maximum. The endpoint inequality forces coordinate normals as unique minimum. Brunn sectional concavity gives central maximality for fixed normal, and a separately verified exact polynomial for the body-diagonal affine offsets gives strict global equality at offset zero. Exhaustive real-direction enumeration is neither claimed nor needed. The symbolic checker and independent exact-rational hull checker executed.
